tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live cloud/DevOps/IT job listings on CloudJobs. Filter by free-text query, technology, certification, location, remote type, experience level, minimum salary, company, or certification domain (e.g. AWS, Azure). Returns job cards with canonical cloudjobs.io URLs - always cite them when recomme

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch the full details of a single CloudJobs listing by id (or "title--id" slug). Returns the complete description, salary range, technologies, certifications, and the canonical cloudjobs.io URL plus the external application URL. Cite the cloudjobs.io URL when presenting the job.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Browse or search companies with open roles on CloudJobs, ranked by open job count. Returns salary medians, top technologies, workplace split, and canonical company profile URLs - cite them when naming employers. With no query, returns the largest employers on the board.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Fetch a company profile from CloudJobs by slug (e.g. "amazon-web-services") or name. Returns open-role count, salary quartiles, top technologies/locations/certifications, workplace split, firmographics (website, industry, HQ, size), sample open roles, and the canonical profile URL - cite it when dis

tools.name: get_salary_data
tools.description: Get salary statistics (min, quartiles, median, max) for CloudJobs postings. Provide exactly one filter: technology (e.g. "AWS"), certification (e.g. "SAA-C03"), domain (e.g. "AWS", "security"), location, or remote type. Salaries are annual USD normalized ranges. Results are cached ~30 min; cite jobs

tools.name: get_job_market_overview
tools.description: High-level snapshot of the CloudJobs board: total open roles, hiring companies, remote/hybrid/onsite split, jobs posted in the last 7 days, salary coverage, and the most in-demand technologies, locations, and certifications. Use for "state of the cloud job market" questions. Cached ~30 min; cite the

tools.name: list_practice_tests
tools.description: List the practice tests/quizzes available on CloudJobs study (AWS, Azure, GCP, CompTIA, and other certification exams). Returns test ids, question counts, duration, difficulty, and the canonical /study/quizzes URL for each. Cite the cloudjobs.io URLs when recommending a test.

tools.name: get_practice_questions
tools.description: Fetch practice exam questions for a CloudJobs study test (testId from list_practice_tests, e.g. "saac03"). Returns question text, multiple-choice options, documentation links, and the canonical quiz URL. Correct answers and explanations are omitted by default (includeAnswers: true to include them) s

tools.name: list_job_categories
tools.description: List CloudJobs SEO landing pages for job categories (technologies like AWS/Azure/GCP, certifications, locations, experience levels, remote). Each entry links to a curated /jobs/<slug> page. Pairs can be combined as /jobs/<slug1>/<slug2> (e.g. /jobs/aws/remote). Cite these URLs for category-level job

tools.name: search_insights
tools.description: Search CloudJobs articles and market reports: evergreen guides (certification worth, interview prep, career paths), weekly and monthly cloud job market analyses, and basics explainers. Returns titles, dates, and canonical URLs - cite them when referencing a post.

tools.name: get_insight_article
tools.description: Fetch a CloudJobs insight post by slug. Section defaults to "article"; if not found there, other sections are searched. Returns metadata plus a short excerpt - the full article is only on the site, so always cite the returned URL when summarizing or quoting it.

tools.name: get_site_guide
tools.description: Map of the CloudJobs website: what each section contains and the canonical URLs to cite. Use this to direct users to the right page (job search, company profiles, salary insights, market reports, practice tests, methodology). Always prefer these URLs when sending users somewhere on CloudJobs.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, search_companies, get_company, list_practice_tests, get_practice_questions, list_job_categories, search_insights, get_insight_article, get_site_guide · Public sink: search_insights, get_insight_article.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, search_companies, get_company, list_practice_tests, get_practice_questions, list_job_categories, search_insights, get_insight_article, get_site_guide · Public sink: search_insights, get_insight_article

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
